_about: One-liners for the diary's Story view (diary.html). Edit freely. Keys are entry kinds; 'death_killer' is used for deaths with a known killer (python diary.py killed-by); 'any' lines are for random 'moment' entries (a picture now and then while you play; how often is set in the helper: Settings > Diary). 'new_region' is the first map of a new region (Victoria Island, Ossyria...). Events always use their own kind's lines. Each line is a string, or {"text": ..., "source": ...}; the source shows as a small tag. Placeholders: {name} (nickname: python diary.py nickname Snoopy) {map} {time} {lv} {prev} {job} {old} {took} {lost} {killer} {why} (first visits: why the map matters, important_maps.json) {region}. A line is skipped for an entry that lacks one of its values. Notes always use their own text. Game lines are our own jokes referencing short catchphrases; keep them short, don't paste long quotes or song lyrics.
